Title: Azure Stream Analytics managed identity authentication to Power BI is now available

Body.Content:
Managed identity authentication for output to Power BI is now generally available in Azure Stream Analytics. This gives Stream Analytics jobs direct access to a workspace within your Power BI account.

Learn how to use managed identity to authenticate Azure Stream Analytics jobs to Power BI.
